hooks.name: Guard the safety wording
hooks.description: Blocks wording that would tell a blind user something is safe when the app does not know.

action.prompt: src/lib/phrasing.ts changed. Re-read .kiro/steering/product.md 'What matters' rule 1. Make sure no sentence says a candy is safe, allergen-free or fine to eat unless the verdict is Safe AND the facts came from label data; inferred allergens must be said as 'likely' and end with 'ask someone to check the label'. Run the phrasing tests.
